comment: Mazak no longer publishes Matrix-generation machines on mazak.com, so these values are from a used-machine dealer listing, not from Mazak: Surplus Record listing 1058083 (surplusrecord.com, 'Mazak #Nexus-530C-II TT, CNC vertical machining center, Mazatrol Matrix Nexus 2 Control', 2014): travels from its description 41.3 x 20.88 x 20.08 in (1049.02 x 530.352 x 510.032 mm; its title says 20.8 for Y and Z), 12000 rpm, 15 hp 30 min rating (11.19 kW), CAT-40, 30 tools, rapid 1417.3 in/min (35999.42 mm/min). Torque, cutting feed, tool change time, acceleration and rigid tapping are not stated there: 0 / false = unknown. Axis directions are not stated; travels are given from 0. Post: mazak-matrix (MAZATROL Matrix family, EIA/ISO; written without a Mazak manual, see docs/post_review/mazak-matrix.md). Not verified on a real machine.
name: Generic Mazak VMC, MAZATROL Matrix, EIA/ISO programs (VCN-530C class)
